out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Holding Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not routinely monitoring the temperatures of Time/Temperature Control for Safety foods during hot and cold holding. Observed repetitive hot holding violations and cold holding improper temperatures in various units.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or Certified Food Manager shall designate employees to monitor the cold holding and hot holding of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure proper temperatures. ENSURE TEMPERATURES ARE BEING MONITORED FOR COLD AND HOT HOLDING FOODS THROUGHOUT THE DAY. A RISK CONTROL PLAN WILL BE IMPLEMENTED WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at cook line handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the cook line hand sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. ENSURE A HAND WASHING SIGN IS PLACED AT THE HAND SINK BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Record System, Label/Tags
violations.observation: Inadequate record keeping system of molluscan shellfish tags. The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not available or are discarded immediately after the container is empty. PIC COULD NOT PROVIDE SHELL STOCK TAGS FOR SHUCKED RAW OYSTERS SERVED ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock tags shall remain attached to the container in which the shellstock are received until the container is empty. CDI: PIC WILL DISCONTINUE SELLING THESE OYSTERS. ENSURE SHELL STOCK TAGS ARE KEPT IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER FOR 90 DAYS. KEEP THE CURRENT TAG WITH OYSTERS AND WRITE THE LAST ONE SOLD ON THE TAG.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 165F
violations.observation: The following poultry item was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: bone-in chicken at 145-155 F when pulled out of the oven.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as poultry, wild game animals, stuffed fish, stuffed meat, stuffed pasta, stuffed poultry, stuffed ratites, or stuffing containing any of these raw animal foods shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165F for at least 15 seconds. CDI: THE CHICKEN WAS PUT BACK IN THE OVEN FOR FURTHER COOKING. WHEN DONE COOKING, THE CHICKEN WAS TEMPED AT 174 F.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: birria sauce (120 F) in the HH box (6) at the cook line and birria sauce (116 F) in HH warmer at the expo line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BOTH BIRRIA SAUCES WERE REHEATED ON THE STOVE. ONE BIRRIA SAUCE REHEATED TO 178 F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) tomatillo sauce (74 F), chipotle sauce (73 F), garlic/oil sauce (72 F) in sauce bottles on the counter top at the cook line for 1.5 hours. 2) cooked spinach on ice bath at cook line (74 F) for 1.5 hrs. The ice was mostly melted. 3) cut lettuce (52 F), cut kale (46 F), cut cabbage (44 F), caesar dressing (44 F) in the 2-door prep unit (8) at the cook line for 1 hr. Ambient temperature of the unit read 43 F. 4) cut tomatoes (61 F) on ice bath for two hours at the expo line. The ice was melted.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. 1) SAUCE BOTTLES HAVE 2.5 HOURS LEFT TO BE USED. PIC PLACED THE START AND END TIMES FOR EACH SAUCE BOTTLE. 2) PIC REPLACED MELTED ICE. COOKED SPINACH HAS 2.5 HOURS LEFT TO BE USED UP. PIC PLACED START AND END TIMES ON THE CONTAINER. 3) PIC PLACED ICE BATH UNDERNEATH ALL FOODS. CUT CABBAGE WAS TAKEN TO THE WIC FOR A QUICK CHILL. 4) PIC REPLACED THE ICE. THE TOMATOES WERE TAKEN TO THE WIC FOR A QUICK CHILL.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Chemicals for Washing Fruits & Vegetables
violations.observation: Chemicals that are being used to wash or peel raw, whole fruits and vegetables do not meet the requirements of 21 CFR 173.315. The concentration of the veggies wash solution was measured at 9.80 milliiters. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Chemicals used to wash or peel, raw whole fruits and vegetables must be approved as food additives or recognized as safe. CDI: WATER WAS ADDED TO DILUTE THE CONCENTRATION TO 7.81 MILLILITERS. PIC WILL CONTACT TECHNICIAN TO ADJUST THE VEGGIE WASH DISPENSER.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed fruit flies where produce is being stored in front of the walk in cooler (meat) and prep areas. Observed several flies on a bag of onions.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC CALLED PEST CONTROL COMPANY FOR SERVICE. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITHIN 10 DAYS. BAG OF ONIONS WERE DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxed beverages on the floor in the dry storage area on the top floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ENSURE ALL FOODS ARE KEPT OFF THE FLOOR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: utensils stored in a dipping well at 123 F with the water turned off.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: PIC TURNED ON THE WATER

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) two-door prep/cooler unit (8) at 43 F, 2) water at the bottom interior of the one-door prep unit (7) at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. ENSURE THE UNIT IS FIXED BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floors on the cook line is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. ENSURE THE FLOORING IS IN GOOD REPAIR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Cooked pork belly was being stored under Raw tuna in the meat walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE COOKED MEAT NEXT TO THE RAW TUNA AND UNDER MORE COOKED PORK BELLY. BARTACO (Inspection Date: 04/29/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR under counter Hot Box next to taco station: black beans (121f) 2) Birria sauce in a squeeze bottle in countertop steam well: (105f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT THE BEANS AND SAUCE ON THE FLAT TOP TO A MINIMUM OF 165f. AFTER PROPER REHEATING, FOOD MAY BE PROPERLY HOT HELD AT A MINIMUM OF 135f. BLACK BEANS WERE OBSERVED AT 178f. BIRRIA SAUCE WAS OBSERVED AT 198f. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAY BE WARRANTED IF THIS CONTINUES.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) observed a tray of Raw shelled eggs being stored on top of unsalted butter in the Raw meat walk-in
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF WITH THE OTHER RAW SHELLED EGGS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) unsalted butter was observed at 80f. Upon discussion with PIC, unsalted butter was placed out 1 hour prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD THE UNSALTED BUTTER IN 3 HOURS. PLEASE LABEL THE TIME THAT THE UNSALTED BUTTER WAS SET OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED (4 hours later) EVERY TIME.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR homestyle mini fridge, milk was observed at 45f. Upon discussion with PIC, milk was placed in the mini fridge 1 hour prior to inspection; 2) at the bar, honeydew purée was observed at 57f. Upon discussion with PIC, honeydew purée was placed on the line 1 hour prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE MILK AND HONEYDEW PURÉE TO A WORKING COOLER TO LOWER THE TEMPERATURE TO 41f.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) roasted tomatillos in the produce walk-in cooler; 2) honeydew purée in a squeeze bottle next to the ice bin at the bar
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Observed Raw ground beef being stored above Raw cod on the speed rack.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC MOVED THE RAW GROUND BEEF UNDER THE RAW COD ON THE SPEED RACK.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Using PIC’s high temperature dish plate, the high temperature dish machine was observed at 152f.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION. WASHING AND RINSING MAY OCCUR IN THE DISH MACHINE. SANITATION MUST OCCUR IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK DISHS FOR 30 TO 60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. PIC WILL CONTACT SERVICE TECHNICIAN. BARTACO (Inspection Date: 05/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Birria sauce in a squeeze bottle was observed at 90f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE BIRRIA SAUCE TO 165f.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC TOOK A PICTURE OF THE APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The handsink along the cook line was observed leaking. The prep sink next to the high temperature dish machine was observed leaking
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR THE LEAKING FAUCETS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.observation: The handwashing sink at Kitchen area near dish washing station is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed handwashing sink not being able to meet 100F
